summary: Existence of a chosen diffuse triple of large eigenvectors does not imply any nontrivial physical cross block or high-window diffuseness when eigenvalues repeat. Exact witness: A=I_n. Any three flat orthonormal Walsh/Hadamard vectors are legitimate +1 eigenvectors with selected-frame leverage 3/n, while every physical cross block is zero and the full |lambda|>=1/64 projector is I. This refutes only a basis-dependent selected-eigenframe reduction, not QFORM.
correct_replacement: Phrase the diffuse branch using basis-invariant spectral-window projection leverage and combine its heavy complement with local/grouped/global-ridge mechanisms.
